name: Diskover
tagline: An open source file system indexer that uses Elasticsearch to index and manage data across heterogeneous storage systems.
description: Diskover is an open source file system indexer that uses Elasticsearch to index and manage data across heterogeneous storage systems.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/diskover:2.3.5@sha256:f352b7726ef85b1ea8e157d99f42c9abeed9e2e547b46ebeae19e2a7110fd8a4
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      ES_HOST: ''
      ES_PORT: ''
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data
        target: /data
